searchText: <@360491619402776577> , Since the sync from scratch is taking much longer, we are trying to restore a snapshot taken from previous get . What we are seeing is that with the snapshot (few days old only) restored geth is still starting to sync all the way from back . Question: When geth client starts , does it look to see if there is data already present? Are there any flags that control it? Seems like it is syncing from start. Appreciate your inputs . Thanks To add more context, this is a custom snapshot we take of the btrfs file system It should continue from the snapshot. If some data is not there, the node might try to repair it Hmm a disk snapshot should contain all data
